## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Fix one Critical defect before merge: a missing results file now makes the release gate pass. The new `FileNotFoundError` fallback in `load_results` returns `[]`, and `release_allowed` calls `all([])` on it, which is `True`. This review traced both call paths in `app/results.py`, checked every caller of these functions in the repository, and read the three added tests without running them. `display_preferences` has a comment explaining its fallback, and both of its branches are tested.

## Changes
`load_results` now returns an empty list when the results file is missing. The PR also adds `display_preferences`, which falls back to a light theme when no preferences file exists, a module constant `REVIEW_NOTE`, and tests for the release gate and preferences loading.

## Critical
- app/results.py:8 — silent-failure — Fail the release gate when results are missing — If `results.json` is missing, `release_allowed` returns `True` and the release goes ahead. `load_results` catches `FileNotFoundError` and returns `[]`, and `release_allowed` (app/results.py:12) evaluates `all(row["passed"] for row in [])`, which is `True`. Nothing is logged and the caller gets no signal; the old code raised in this case. No test covers the missing-results path; `test_saved_checks_control_release` only uses a file that exists. — A deleted, mislocated, or never-written results file opens the release gate with no checks run, so untested builds can ship with no record of why. — Fix: Let `FileNotFoundError` propagate from `load_results`, or catch it in `release_allowed` and return `False`. Add a test asserting that `release_allowed(tmp_path / "missing.json")` is false or raises.
